description: A ground-level photograph shows a wide, open landscape primarily composed of dry, yellowish-brown grasses and sparse low-lying scrubland extending towards a flat horizon. The sky is clear blue with a few wispy white clouds. The overall appearance is consistent with natural grassland or heathland and scrub environments, as referenced in the accompanying document context regarding CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classifications. In the bottom-left corner, the text "©European Union, 2012" and "LULUC" are visible.
